RAZORPAY_KEY_ID.description: Razorpay states nothing about exposing this half, and this registry did not confirm a browser role for it, so it stays secret. That is the cautious direction: a key wrongly kept private costs a build step, one wrongly published cannot be recalled.

RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET.description: Razorpay says not to share it anywhere public, and shows it only once. Generating a replacement lets you deactivate the old key at once or after twenty-four hours.
